requirements_correctness.rationale: The student's 24 baseline capabilities are broad, well-grounded and often more accurate than the reference (ProximitySensor condition, HasDialingMaximum quirk, event-result chain, antifraud detail), but three clusters of behaviours the reference covers correctly are missing: service-level behaviours of call_manager_service.cpp (InputDialerSpecialCode, SendCallUiEvent routing, SetCallPolicyInfo, voice-mail count reset, GetProxyObjectPtr), the OOBE-rejection and ESIM one-number-dual-terminal branches in the uplink state machine, and the CRS video-ring plus VideoStateUpdated voice/video device-switch chains in the audio module. Several medium gaps -> 3.

scenario_quality.rationale: Scenarios are generally concrete (error codes, functions, injected stub values, timings) and expand decision chains better than the reference in places, but the deltas systematically pad near-duplicate scenarios: the same WHEN/THEN restated under two titles (~11 pairs in call-state-observer delta alone; 374 scenarios total vs 143), which the rubric explicitly penalizes. In addition, safety-relevant ECC behaviour has scenarios but no gtest task (only a review item), while the reference has explicit ECC gtests. One high-severity plus one medium gap -> 3.

design_quality.rationale: The design is unusually concrete (file-by-file deletion lists, per-macro placement table, stub naming, todo tag table, risks, rollback) and covers concurrency and the direct-call/stub architecture well. However: the proposal's claimed CRS (video ring) trim is never turned into code-level actions (no design decision, no delta Migration entry, unlike the reference); the student's own artifacts contradict each other (design deletes call_manager_proxy.cpp while the client-framework delta still specifies registration via CallManagerProxy::RegisterCallBack; the call-report delta silently collapses the state-registry dual route to a single slotId route with no proposal/design trace and no AGENTS.md basis); and knock-on effects are only half-handled (waiting-tone chain kept while its first step into the removed IMSCall video machine is silently dropped; design's removed-callType drop rule vs delta keeping UpdateOttEventInfo dispatch; FoldStatusManager listener cleanup not listed). Several medium gaps -> 3.

readability.rationale: zh-CN prose with English OpenSpec keywords, 25-row trim table, per-capability deltas, decision index with 决策/理由/落点, real open questions, tables for enumerations, no long code blocks. Minor deductions only: the near-duplicate scenario pairs inflate and repeat content, a few delta requirement/scenario titles are kept while their THEN now asserts the opposite (e.g. 六类通话对象按类型构造 now describing two types; IMS 对象构造后初始化视频状态 whose THEN says InitVideoCall is not called), and some WHEN clauses embed rationale. 4.

AGENTS.md lists 通知 (NotificationHelper) and 功耗锁 (ABILITY_POWER_SUPPORT) as '暂不调用 -> todo 占位' dependencies and does not list incoming-call notification / missed-call reminder / incoming wakeup among unsupported features, yet the reference deletes incoming_call_notification.cpp, missed_call_notification.cpp, incoming_call_wake_up.cpp and the ABILITY_POWER_SUPPORT gni block outright; the student keeps them as todo placeholders, which matches the constraints more literally. Flag for the human reviewer since dependency handling is script-scored.
